albumOrderFix: The four 23:30 messages were harvested in the WRONG ORDER. The chat gave player(4), kids(3), retro(3), windbreaker(1); the photographs say retro(3), windbreaker(1), player(4), kids(3). The tell is the shorts - a kids set is the only album whose photographs show a shirt AND shorts, and the only three such photographs are p515-p517, which the old order handed to 'retro'. captions.tsv was reordered and align-0905.mjs re-run: still 664 assigned, zero drift, nothing left over. All four messages share the minute 23:30, and within-minute order is the one thing the harvester reconstructs rather than reads (smallest offsetTop), so it is exactly where this fails. Check any minute that carries several albums.

notes.albums: Six albums after the reorder: retro (3), windbreaker (1), player version (4), kids set (3), player version (1), fan version (6).
notes.dedupe: The store carried NO Newcastle United products at all before this batch, so nothing could be a duplicate. All 18 are new.
notes.seasonReading: The sponsor dates these precisely: Newcastle Brown Ale to 2000, northern rock 2003-2012, Sela 2023-2026, KNOX Hydrate from 2026/27. Every garment here is datable, so no title needed a colour fallback.
